title: Evaluation / PoC project
content:
The evaluation project is ment to prepare for a coming project based pilot project.

We need to create or evaluate:

  • How to get access and manage users in CBF GitHub.
  • How to integrate with Jira and get the workflow we have today functioning.
  • Create a step by step procedure how to setup and migrate to GitHub, to be used by the pilot project.


See meeting notes for more information: 


PoC Status

Jira project to be used has been created: https://i-p-e-x.atlassian.net/browse/GP

Could be that webhooks and apps need to be installed / setup on a site level and not on a project level.
